reviews.author: david kraft
reviews.text: We let this man work on our truck give us all sorts of promises did not deliver any put parts on that we’re not needed sad parts were replaced they did not need replacing chargers for parts Tavern I put on the car example exhaust manifold bolts chargers for an exhaust manifold kit but yet there’s a retaining bolt missing chargers for a battery that he said was six years old which I had paperwork to show it was still good for six months raised his price before he would release our vehicle he had all vehicle from Bridge city here till May his mechanics quit on him while we were there having ours resurfaced when I questioned the part as to why the condition was what it was oil dipstick was not secured. Transmission dipstick was not secured, which Tire And Battery has been leaking oil out the Plenum head gasket since we got it back. Cannot find anybody to work on it after he has worked on it. When I questioned him about all the parts, he refused to look at it do not be stupid enough to let this man work on your vehicle I can show you the proof. I can show you our truck we’re still trying to get somebody to fix it properly very unprofessional repair facility

reviews.author: michael M
reviews.text: Gavin and his Crew Got me right within a few days of having some severe front end issues. Also communicated everything they were doing. All while keeping a super positive attitude!

reviews.author: William Strobert
reviews.text: Loyalty, Duty, Respect, Selfless-Service, Honor, Integrity, and Personal Courage, are the seven Army Values I lived by for 10 years, and still strive to maintain since my separation. I can confidently say that Gavin holds none on these values, as a business owner, as a Man, he should at least uphold a few of them, yet he fails at every level. Do not take anything you care for to this man. V/R SSG Strobert

reviews.author: Robert Tindale
reviews.text: Gavin is a honest fairly price, he is willing to help anybody with their vehicle. He is straight forward.

reviews.author: Bettina Katrice
reviews.text: DO NOT and I repeat DO NOT let this mechanic work on your car, he is the worse, he lie about the initial amount and then end up increasing your price, his communication sucks, I am a single mother and the price that he charged me for my vehicle was ridiculous! When I say run, run far away from this mechanic! NEVER AGAIN! They say support your own race, however he will not be anyone I would ever support, and I will make sure to spread the word on how bad his services and customer service skills are! I had to rate! If I could., I would have given him a 0 star rating!

reviews.author: Zach Volpi
reviews.text: Gavin is a fair and honest guy. Took both my Jeeps to him over the course of the last few months for both minor and major repairs. Not only was he up front about the issues but he fixed everything in a timely manner. If any of my vehicles ever have an issue, I will be taking them right to Aiken Automotive. Great prices, Great work and great mechanic. Thanks again Gavin!

reviews.author: Trevor Price
reviews.text: I recently visited Aiken Automotive Repair for car repairs and was thoroughly impressed. Gavin, a skilled technician, provided exceptional service. He quickly diagnosed and explained the issues clearly. The repairs were completed efficiently and to a high standard. Throughout the process, Gavin and the team were professional and kept me informed. I highly recommend Aiken Automotive Repair for their expertise and excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Donna Bryan
reviews.text: I had a problem with my engine coolant sensor and called several places to get a quote. Some places wanted to charge me as much as $1500 to get the part replaced and repaired. Gavin charged me half that and did an excellent job in the minimal amount of time. He was very professional, kind, and understanding. I called him on a Saturday morning and my car was fixed by Saturday afternoon. I cannot say enough about Gavin and how much of a blessing he was to me the day that my car was repaired.

reviews.author: Shannon Brown
reviews.text: Gavin did a great job on my car. It had several issues and he did a great job repairing them all. Prices were good and service was quick. Definitely would recommend Gavin to take care of all your auto needs.

reviews.author: Rewa Milton
reviews.text: I had my car towed to this shop when it broke down on I20. I don’t live in Aiken so I didn’t have any prior knowledge of what kind of service I would get. This was the best decision ever. I spoke to Gavin. After he looked at my vehicle he was able to tell me exactly what was going wrong, what was needed to fix it, and how much it would cost. He gave me some suggestions about future repairs. He was honest and efficient. I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Yvee Kilnham
reviews.text: I wouldn’t even give a single star. Negative stars aren’t offered. This man has Had our vehicle -held hostage - since mid-December last year! After we made the BIG mistake of paying him UP FRONT at his request a total of $5150 (that he claimed was required to repair the car), everything soon changed. He continued running us down a rabbit hole claiming more and more costly repairs were required. We told him we’re not putting any more money in the vehicle than what we’ve given him, and please restore the car to running condition and return it to us. Non-responsive to our multiple requests to find out when we can get our car back - then absolutely nothing - crickets ever since! He hasn’t tried to contact us, apologize, redeem himself, pick up phone -absolutely NOTHING! Paid in full $5150 and keeps OUR car! I can’t believe this man is running a business! He’s an amazing manipulator -probably one of best I’ve ever encountered-and I’m no pushover. He will charm your socks off - until he gets what he wants - your money - and up front. Not sure if we’ll ever get vehicle back or if we even want it because we have NO idea what he’s done or not done. This is heartbreaking and has been an ongoing nightmare and that’s an understatement. My husband bought that car for me and I loved that car. It’s not over Gavin. Going ALL the way with this and Karma is coming. Should truly be ashamed. Clearly after all this time, not, and that’s a shame. See you in court and soon! KJV Isaiah 54:17

reviews.author: Jonesy
reviews.text: Great experience overall. Mr. Price gave me a reasonable price on my car’s repair, in comparison to other shops around. He also informed me of other things going on with my vehicle to look out for in the future. Very patient and observant of my issues, and diligent with responses. I will definitely refer anyone to this shop, it saved me a lot of money and kept me from doing the labor myself.

reviews.author: April McCall
reviews.text: I recently had to have my water pump, pulley, belt, and thermostat replaced. Gavin did an amazing job. It was done in a timely manner and the pricing was agreeable. Highly recommend him for any work needed.

reviews.author: Tara Chipman
reviews.text: Recently took my Jeep in for exhaust work. Gavin gave a a quote and did warn me of another potential issue they may come up. So when he called to tell me there was more extensive work to be done I want surprised. Job was completed when he said it would me at a fair price. My BumbleBee is running g great again!

reviews.author: Kyla Porter
reviews.text: Potential customer here, however after reading the reviews,. I think not, I’m an 18 year old black young woman so I wonder how he would have done me, no thanks! Word of advance!!!!! Let this mechanic be your last resort!!!! Look around and get second opinions before trusting him with your vehicle!!!! Good luck to the ones who had bad experiences with this guy! #GodDoesn’tLikeUgly!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Sylv Humphries
reviews.text: Harper Automotive Repair did outstanding work on two of my husband and my vehicles. We were and are satisfied with the substantial work done, his expertise, his professionalism and his honesty. He explained what was needed and was upfront with the cost, supplying a written estimate. We paid the invoice in full for a job more than well done. He will remain our mechanic, as he values his work and provides service with a smile and wonderful effortless customer service.

reviews.author: troy nipper
reviews.text: I have only had the best experiences with Aiken Automotive Repair, Mr. Price is honest, trustworthy, reliable and able accurately diagnose the problem. I have total confidence in having my cars repaired with Aiken Automotive Repair. I certainly would and do recommend Aiken Automotive Repair and Mr. Gavin Price!

reviews.author: Mercedes Robertson
reviews.text: After experiencing unsatisfactory service from another local shop, I was referred by a friend to Harper Automotive. Each time I have been in for routine service or to diagnose an issue, the work has been completed correctly and promptly. A light come on my dash and my Nissan Altima started acting funny so I called Mr. Price. He let me go ahead and bring it in. Come to find out it was something dealing with all Nissan’s. Mr. Price not only called Nissan dealership got me an appointment before my trip he also the day of the appointment followed my husband to drop it off and brought him home so I wouldn’t have to get off work. I can confidently recommend Mr.Price to anyone.

reviews.author: Juan Aguilar Jaramillo
reviews.text: If I could give negative stars I would. This is the most POS mechanic I’ve encountered in Aiken. He will over charge you for his services. I brought my vehicle for an AC repair, he charged me for the diagnostic and for getting it “fixed”. When I came back to get my vehicle he said he couldn’t fix my AC so I asked for a refund for what he didn’t fix and was denied. Please stay away from this place their mechanic is a fraud.

reviews.author: Sherri pepper
reviews.text: Gavin Price has always done right by me. I am taking my vehicle to him next week. I need a welder and he's the best!

reviews.author: lindsey Heyward
reviews.text: My car was done in a timely manner, mechanic was very nice and attentive. Great pricing, and easy to make an appointment. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Christopher Graham
reviews.text: The worst place I ever went to get my car worked on. Gavin is the worst mechanic. He took 5100 hundred dollars from me. The same thing I paid him for I have the same issues. Every time I took I back to him it was lies after lies. If I had enough room to tell the whole story I would. But please don’t go there it’s the worst place ever.

reviews.author: Cyn Phillips
reviews.text: Did work on my PT cruiser a few months ago. I was doing a winter tune-up, noticed a few things. One thing I noticed immediately was my throttle body housing left in the rear seat and not reinstalled.. Thats okay. I popped it back on, no big deal. I know my car was a mess, and you think i don't know whats there, but best believe I know what was taken out of it, like my car charger i use daily, but those small things can be replaced. What I **DONT** like, is that you charged a woman $40 for antifreeze and didn't put a single drop in it. Yeah, when i brought the car in, it had just water in it because it was leaking and I knew from where, but didn't have the equipment to fix it. I was also failed to keep informed and did extra work without discussing. If I didn't have the money you would have just laughed and used me as a story like you had about someone else who couldn't pay so you sold their car. Thats not a joking matter and not professional for a business owner to tell a customer. I understand driving with bad mounts is dangerous, but upon examining the mounts that were installed, maybe next time make sure they are installed correctly so the boots don't crack. You also failed to put my radiator reservoir cap back on. I wasn't going to say anything and just let it go, but I don't want someone to almost get killed because you or your apprentice overtightened or lost parts.

reviews.author: Jon Walker
reviews.text: It was a motor replacement for Bettina heath .. the start up down payment and what is the remaining balance.. just to get the wrong motor and charge extra for the mistake.. not asking the customer to do other repairs and charge extra that wasn't stated in the beginning.. bad business just want our car back at the start price

reviews.author: Telana Kabisch
reviews.text: This guy is nice and manipulative. He took advantage of my lack of knowledge about cars. I ended up paying $1,400 for a brake job and he didn't even bled my brakes properly. I drove around for a week on very spongy and dull brakes. It was dangerous and scary. He told me that my master cylinder needed to be replaced but when I took the car to another mechanic they told me the master was fine and that the car wasn't bled.

reviews.author: Mercedes guy
reviews.text: Gavin has helped me out a lot with my vehicles and even checked my work to make sure that I had done things properly. Will definitely use him in the future and highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Sadia Jhamant
reviews.text: Let’s be real, Right is Right Wrong is Wrong!! Harpers Automotive Mobile Repair Charged me $850 for a Diagnostic's just to tell me that my engine is bad. This price is totally unreasonable and is just another way for them to keep your vehicle by applying for a Mechanic Lien. They are very rude on the phone and seem to enjoy the fact that if you don't pay for their overpriced service that they will obtain a title for your car by applying for a mechanic lien. I will be filing a complaint to the BBB to make sure that others know about the bad business that this Company does.

reviews.author: Emilee Losier
reviews.text: Honest, reliable, fair and easy to work with! Ive never had a car guy but after my recent visit, I will be returning and referring others also!

reviews.author: SuzAnn Vance
reviews.text: Highly recommend Gavin and his crew! They are conscientious, knowledgeable, and very easy to work with. This is my new go-to shop for repairs and maintenance.

reviews.author: Regina Snipes
reviews.text: Gavin was very nice and professional. He went out of his way to help me. I will refer him to everyone I know. Thanks Gavin

reviews.author: Brandon Jamison
reviews.text: Very professional and communicates very well. He diagnosed my problem, explained what was needed to fix it and repaired it expeditiously! Great quality work!

reviews.author: Centrell Williams
reviews.text: Gavin prices are very compatible and very affordable I wouldnt go anywhere else thanks for having good techs like Gavin!

reviews.author: O'Bryan Roper
reviews.text: Has worked on four of my vehicles all different makes and models. Never had a problem, he’s quick, communicates effectively, and is honest.

reviews.author: Jude Adney
reviews.text: Great guy, knows what he’s doing. Familiar with the panther platforms, and does all sorts of work with them. Only guy in town brave enough to replace rear axle fluid. Remembered the additive. 10/10.

reviews.author: Argus Sanders
reviews.text: I was trying get the oil changed and some things checked on my car. Wasn't interested in helping me.

reviews.author: brodee stewart
reviews.text: Super great and honest guy. Took great care of my car and showed me proof of everything that was wrong with the car. Will be using him from now on.

reviews.author: Danielle McCain
reviews.text: •Professional •Honest •Fair •Affordable •Friendly I trust Harper Automotive Mobile Repair with all of vehicles’ service needs and if you haven’t, then you should.
